resolvedFindings.title: Mandatory comparator parameters are not public receipt fields
resolvedFindings.evidence: The comparator requires rate8/100,period31/365 and floor remainder54/73. Public loan KernelState/Result0 exposes after-state,remaining,revision and effects, not those source parameters or division hints. The original packet required every financial leaf to derive solely from observed receipt/readback fields. Literal compliance could not populate the mandatory comparator schema.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The only packet diff replaces the projection paragraph. It permits exact pinned source-derived parameters and explicit integer arithmetic over observed/source-derived inputs, requires verified deployed programDigest and kernel correspondence, classifies every leaf, and requires actual readback for outcomes. Expected fixture leaves cannot fill missing observations. Source constants are never mislabeled observed.

checks.topic: Public receipt schema and private boundaries
checks.evidence: FinalizedTxData exposes tx,status,txId,identifiers,txHash,blockHash,height,timestamp,protocolVersion,fees,segmentStatusMap and unshielded summaries. FinalizedCallTxData and FinalizedDeployTxData inherit private fields. The packet allows only selected public fields and preserves failed public receipts through TxFailedError.finalizedTxData. Real serialized markers are signature/proof/binding. Canonical decoding is structural evidence, not proof validity or chain inclusion by itself. Independent actual finality remains mandatory.

UtxoSpend includes intentHash,outputNo,type,value and owner as SignatureVerifyingKey. addressFromKey converts that key to UserAddress. Intent.signatureData(segment) and each offer signatures array support independent per-slot verification. The packet correctly requires complete guaranteed/fallible offer retention and original association, rather than total-only checks. Indexer summaries omit outputNo, so raw offers remain authoritative for identities.

checks.topic: Block-bound state, fees and failed segments
checks.evidence: Both queryContractState and queryUnshieldedBalances support a BlockHashConfig. Indexer data exposes paid/estimated fees and segment status. The packet preserves FailFallible guaranteed effects and fees, rejects it as a successful stage, and blocks unresolved required fees. The ledger fees API describes units as SPECKs. A full private DUST witness is correctly not promised.

The unchanged comparator validates synthetic-local and always returns networkAcceptance:false. The revised packet retains the real receipt separately, classifies all projection leaves, binds source parameters to actual deployed programDigest, and forbids expected fixtures from filling absent observations. Arithmetic success cannot establish ownership, color/address binding, fees, canonical block or finality.
